lowres_ok: Nintendo's Switch 2 store trailers (US nsuid 70010000130792, 1280x720, three videos) are the only official copies; Nintendo's YouTube channel is not reachable here (sign-in wall) and no 1080p press-kit file is public
note: HELD FOR MOHAMMAD'S PREVIEW, not scheduled. Nintendo Ask the Developer Vol. 24, Ocarina of Time, Chapters 3 and 4 (nintendo.com/en-gb, 3 Nov 2026, translated from Japanese). Beats from the pages: auto-jump removed, jump anywhere with one button (Ng); Aonuma could not get used to the two-step Jump Attack from Breath of the Wild, so a one-button version was added, both kept; Water Temple adjusted (easier item toggling, lattice walls); more than 150 background music pieces, full orchestra, some pieces recreate N64 sounds from the original sound source (Ohashi); ocarina by humming into the Switch 2 microphone. Footage: Nintendo store Switch 2 trailer (the long montage, 720p, only official copy), music stem only; no speech. No person photo in this cut (people rule: add Aonuma photo from Nintendo's page if he wants).
